<div class="card-body">
'''Comlink''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">コムリンク</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、任意のキャラクターに配備する。敵が、コムリンクのあるロケーションかその隣接する位置で、戦闘かフォース消耗を起こそうとした場合、リアクションとして、その位置にカードを配備することができる。配備コストは通常通り支払う。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-201o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Comlink (Japanese)]], checked line by line against this Two-Player face. The last line follows this face, which clearly reads 配備コストは通常通り支払う。 (the Premiere photo cuts that line off).</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Comlink-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">携帯用通信機。軍用コムリンクは、戦闘時や緊急時の機密保護のため、スクランブラーと周波数変更システムが組み込まれている。</span>''<ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Comlink.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any character. If the opponent is about to initiate a battle or Force drain at the Comlink's location or an adjacent site, you may react by deploying cards there. Deploy cost is paid as normal.

'''Lore:''' A handheld communicator. Military comlinks include a scrambler and frequency-change system to keep battles and emergencies secure.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Comlink]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
